 Drizzle Today Gives Way to Frost and Freeze This Weekend 
 Frost expected Saturday By Byron Douglas Published : Nov. 6, 2026 at 5:07 AM CST | Updated : 13 hours ago Share Add Us On Google Add as a preferred source on Google EVANSVILLE, Ind. (WFIE) -Cloudy skies and patchy drizzle today will give way to dry but cool weather over the weekend. However, the real story is the cold air moving in — areas of frost are expected Saturday, with freezing conditions possible in rural, low-lying areas Sunday morning. This is the coldest air we’ve experienced since late March. 
 Watch 14 News when we are live, right here: 
 Drizzle Early, Then Clearing
 Today will start with low clouds and a few sprinkles this morning, but conditions will slowly clear this afternoon. High temperatures will reach 56 degrees.
 Tonight will be clear and colder with lows dropping to 33 degrees — the first sign of the significant cold arriving.
 Frost Advisory Saturday
 Saturday will be under a Frost Advisory until 8am. Sunny skies will develop during the morning, then conditions will become mostly sunny throughout the day. High temperatures will reach 55 degrees.
 If you have tender plants, vegetables, or gardens still in the ground, take steps to protect them before Saturday morning. The frost advisory means frost is expected in most areas.
 Saturday night will be clear and cold with lows dropping to 32 degrees.
 Freeze Watch Sunday Morning
 Sunday will be under a Freeze Watch until 8am. Freezing conditions are possible in rural, low-lying areas as temperatures dip to near or below 32 degrees.
 Sunday will warm up nicely during the day with sunny skies and highs reaching 62 degrees, but that early morning freeze will be the story.
